faq.q: How much does Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers charge?
faq.a: Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers have offices?
faq.a: Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers publishes four offices, in San Antonio, Austin, El Paso and Corpus Christi. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers?
faq.a: Wayne Wright Injury Lawyers names six attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
